description: Receiver typed atom (or any): dispatch over modules World has referenced that define f/n; a miss raises UndefinedFunctionError (rescuable), a non-atom raises ArgumentError with Elixir's text. Candidate set is a monotone fact like ProtocolImplProviders, filtered by each module's scope-tier interface for f/n so that no body is defined just to ask. First step, before building: probe whether the filter stays at the interface tier without demanding DefineModule, and count the job trace on a hello-world program. Removes M1's plain-atom compile error.
title: A call on a plain-atom receiver dispatches over the modules the program can name
